[SWS_TcpIp_00398]
TCP sockets immediate release in an onhold state ⌈If
TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE is requested and the current state of that EthIf controller
is TCPIP_STATE_ONHOLD, the TcpIp module shall in regards to [SWS_TcpIp_00074]
immediately release TCP sockets without any transmission.⌋
